scope: Unpublished local single-player construction revision and door swing behavior; no exports, deployment, commit or push
features: Correct engine Y-axis footprint rotation and schema1 to schema2 migration
Bottom category catalog with cached real-model thumbnails and contextual selection controls
Independent furniture and ornaments, tabletop/shelf attachment, parent move/rotate/delete and atomic undo
Real fixture lighting with shadows; no automatic room key/fill for player-built rooms
Actual model previews with red conflict overlay for furniture, structures and entire houses
Symmetric player-built wall faces and visibility-only cutaways
Whole-house mouse placement beside existing buildings with unique IDs and attachment remapping
Door leaf and portal pass through actors while swinging; normal collision restored at rest
Local-only navigation bounds guard also supports server hosts
environment: macOS / Apple M1 Pro / Godot 4.6.3 / Metal Forward+; isolated test progress
not_verified: Production deployment or public server state
test_environment_notes: Graphical tests wait for macOS window resize before routing input. Forced render calls are confined to screenshot helpers to avoid waiting indefinitely for frame_post_draw on an occluded/idle native window.

An early local multiplayer probe exposed a pre-existing server-host navigation guard issue; it was fixed and isolated interaction/chat checks passed. The temporary auth service on loopback 18912 was stopped.
The legacy seamless-home mesh check now converts PackedInt32Array to Array before max(); original home entry, seats, cutaway, navigation and door behavior passed for bunny and cat.
